t: There are four fluid storage tanks, imaginatively titled the $(item)Small Tank/$, the $(item)Medium Tank/$, the $(item)Large Tank/$, and the $(item)Huge Tank/$. While $(l:machines/liquid_hopper)Liquid Hoppers/$ are also suitable for fluid storage, these tanks provide denser storage and some useful stacking functionality, and don't automatically transfer fluids (although they can push fluids if a $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)Dispenser Upgrade/$) is added.

这里有四种流体储罐，名字倒也相当直白：$(item)小型油箱/$、$(item)中型油箱/$、$(item)大型燃料缸/$以及$(item)巨型流体储罐/$。虽然$(l:machines/liquid_hopper)流体漏斗/$也适合用于存储流体，但这些储罐能提供更高密度的存储，以及一些实用的堆叠功能，而且不会自动传输流体（不过如果添加了$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)发射器升级/$，它们也可以推出流体）。

All four types of tank can be $(thing)stacked/$ vertically with each other, and formed into a sort-of-multiblock. To do this, right-click the tank with a $(l:tools/pneumatic_wrench)Wrench/$; wrenching the top half will attempt to join the tank to the tank above, and vice versa for the tank below.$(p)Once tanks are stacked, any fluid in $(ttcolor)$(t:If the fluid has a density of < 0, it will move up rather than down)higher tanks/$ will automatically flow down to lower tanks, assuming there is space.

四种储罐都可以彼此垂直$(thing)堆叠/$，组成一种类似多方块结构的装置。要实现这一点，请手持$(l:tools/pneumatic_wrench)扳手/$右键储罐；对上半部分使用扳手会尝试将该储罐与上方的储罐连接，反之，对下半部分使用扳手则会尝试与下方的储罐连接。$(p)储罐堆叠后，$(ttcolor)$(t:密度小于 0 的流体会向上流而不是向下)上方储罐/$中的任何流体都会在下方有空间时自动向下流动。
三个上下堆叠的小型储罐

There are some restrictions to this:$(li)To combine two tanks, either both must contain the same fluid (or no fluid), or one of the tanks must be empty$(li)Fluid will $(italic)not/$ move upwards; therefore fluid should be pumped into the top tank of a stack, and pumped out of the bottom tank for best results$(li)The tank GUI will only show the fluid quantity of the tank that was right-clicked.
这有一些限制：$(li)要将两个储罐合并，要么两者都必须包含相同的流体（或都不含流体），要么其中一个储罐必须为空$(li)流体$(italic)不会/$向上流动；因此，为获得最佳效果，应将流体泵入这组储罐最上方的储罐，并从最下方的储罐中抽出$(li)储罐的 GUI 只会显示你右键点击的那个储罐中的流体数量。
